title: L2Metrics Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration for Neo L2 Metrics HTTP exporter - exposes Prometheus-format metrics endpoint

Enabled.description: Whether metrics HTTP server is active

BindAddress.description: IP address to bind metrics HTTP server to (localhost recommended for production)

Port.description: TCP port for metrics HTTP server (1024+ required on most systems)

MaxConcurrentConnections.description: Maximum simultaneous HTTP connections before returning 503 Service Unavailable
